name: Ozark Mini/Pony Personalized Nylon Halter Avg/Med
description: Ozark Premium Nylon Halter With Personalized Brass Plate for Miniatures and Ponies Made from premium quality, brass plated, 2-ply, 3/4" nylon web with heavy duty hardware, this incredibly well-made halter is not only beautiful but incredibly useful. Grommets allow for easy on and off, while the adjustable chin allows you to tighten or loosen the fit your small equine's nose. You'll appreciate that the eyelet holes are reinforced with grommets to prevent fraying. You'll always grab the correct halter because of the personalized engraved brass plate! Features: Handcrafted in the USA by the Amish Brass plated hardware Brass tags are 2" x 3/4" Matching lead available (item #E023736, sold separately) Item Specifications: Sizes (based on height at withers): Medium: 30"-32" (nose 16"-19", poll 22"-28") Large: 33"-35" (nose 17"-20", poll 23"-29") X-Large: 36"+ (nose 18"-21", poll 26.5"-33") Note: nose and poll measurements approximate. Material: Made with 3/4" nylon web Personalization: Each brass plate can have up to two lines with 20 letters per line. Just pick your halter and add your plate information to the text box below before hitting the "Add to Cart" button. Your halter will be delivered with the engraved plate already attached. Please make sure to double-check your size, because once a tag goes on a product it is non-returnable. Not sure about your size? Just give us a call and we'll help you find the perfect size. Note: Due to their nature, personalized items are not returnable.
